body.claim: STUDY-02 preregistered economics screen for P2/P3 on the frozen 30-day benchmark, run, reported. Descriptive only: no strategy, no candidate, no attempt-budget consumption, no worker-lane file touched, no network, no credentials. Live submission untouched and disabled.
body.why_this_lane: SWEEP-2026-10-16 lists the binding blockers as (1) owner 10-day capture, (2) W2 funding-settlement channel, (3) peer F2 fix. All three are owned/in-flight, so this lane took the highest-value unclaimed work: measuring whether P2/P3 economics justify the capture at all, on data already in the repo ($0), before the owner spends the capture effort. Mirrors STUDY-01's role for the scalp thesis.
headline_results: P2: funding yield 4.37%/4.41% annualized (BTC/ETH), persistence r=0.997, but 1.2bp/day -> breakeven hold 21.6 days at 26bps taker RT. Perp-only taker funding-tilt REJECTED (every multi-trade cell net-negative; price risk dominates funding 1-2 orders of magnitude). The coherent P2 form is delta-neutral spot+perp held for weeks -> needs Vision spot data ($0), NOT the 10-day capture.

P3: cost arithmetic viable at 8-24h (median 24h move 86-111bp vs 26bp hurdle; vs 12x at 60s for the dead scalp). Continuation: ALL 12 BTC/ETH cells net-negative; alt LONG positives (NEAR/STRK/W) sit exactly on the three +130-340% rally coins of this window -> regime artifact across 48 uncorrected cells, not demonstrated edge.
Frozen-rule outcome: H-02 REJECTED (perp-only form); H-03 MERITS-CANDIDATE-EVALUATION with the regime-artifact annotation - any P3 candidate must be preregistered fresh on untouched data.
Capture implication: the 10-day/186GB capture is a P1-only investment. P2/P3 can be measured to decision depth on free Vision data first.
body.deviation_disclosed: Run 1 had a per-side (not per-cell) one-position budget bug that suppressed long-hold cells; fixed to match the prereg's explicit 'of the same cell' wording (P3 wording was ambiguous, implemented per-cell, disclosed in the report). Run 1 was examined only to diagnose the bug; no threshold/window/convention changed after seeing economics.
